SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
458 West Dickens Avenue
From B3-2 to B3-3

No, 22817T1

The Property
The subject property is improved with a mixed-use building of multiple heights containing ground floor

commercial space and residential dwelling units above the ground floor. The surrounding area is comprised of
varying zoning districts, including B3-2, B3-3, RS-3, RT-4, and RM-5 districts, and various Planned
Developments. The area is improved with buildings, with a range of heights, containing residential and
commercial uses. The property is also a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented Provisions of the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance, Section 17-10-0102-B, as it is within 890 feet of the Clark Street Bus Line Corridor Roadway
Segment, and within 1,090 feet of the Lincoln Avenue Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment.

The Project
The Applicant proposes to improve the property by constructing a two-story addition above the commercial space

containing nine dwelling units and 9 bicycle parking spaces. No automobile parking spaces are proposed. The
proposed zoning height of the building will be 37’ 10". To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks
a zoning change for the subject property from a B3-2 Community Shopping District to a B3-3 Community
Shopping District. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning application and seeks all relief necessary, as allowed
by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans, including: 1) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to
reduce the year yard setback from 30 feet to 20 feet; 2) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the front
yard setback to zero feet; 3) a variation under section 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-EE to reduce the number of
Tequired automobile parking spaces from five to zero spaces.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 7,760.27 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 20,585.00 sq. ft.

FAR: 2.65

Residential Dwelling Units: 9

MLA Density: 852.25 sq. ft.

Height: 37 ft. 10 in.

Automobile Parking: 0

Bicycle Parking: 9

Setbacks:
Front (Dickens St.) 0 feet
Rear (Alley) 20.00 feet
Side (North) 0 feet

Side (South) 0 feet
